name: Lanternhall City
chat: I’ve been looking for the exit since Tuesday.
The escalators go up forever. I checked.
Everything’s on sale. Nobody knows what the original price was.
The Concierge Desk can get you anything. Anything.
Maison Margin is up on the mezzanine. Bring a wheelbarrow of money.

props.say: Kiosk: “Try our new scented air. Only 9.99!”
